description: pyResToolbox provides reservoir-engineering calculations for fluid properties, decline curves, material balance, well inflow and lift performance, and simulator input preparation. The maintainer documents reusable modules and Eclipse-compatible engineering units. The provider is Mark W. Burgoyne. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository identifies GPL-3.0. Source access is public; other simulator software has separate terms. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it can prepare reservoir inputs, support well calculations and compare engineering correlations. Related resources: model-geophires-x is a separate subsurface-energy model; this relationship denotes comparable reservoir inputs, not direct integration.
